ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a cross-sectional schematic diagram of a flower, with a green female structure in the center, including the round stigma at the top, the style downward, and the swollen ovary at the bottom. On the right side there is a large brace marking this entire central structure, and the letter label beside it is L. Reasoning: A carpel is the female reproductive organ of a flower, composed of the stigma, style, and ovary. The label marking this entire part of the structure in the image is L, corresponding to the brace on the right side.
